registration.subject: Confirm your SolidPing account
registration.preheader: One click to confirm your address and finish setting up SolidPing.
registration.title: Confirm your account
registration.intro: You're almost there. Click below to confirm your SolidPing account and finish setting things up.
registration.introText: You're almost there. Confirm your SolidPing account to finish setting things up:
registration.expiry: This confirmation link expires in {expiresIn}. If you didn't sign up for SolidPing, you can safely ignore this email.

welcome.title: Welcome to SolidPing
welcome.preheader: Your account is ready. Add your first check in a minute.
welcome.lead: Your account is ready. Three things take five minutes and make it useful:

addCheck.label: 1. Add a check
addCheck.detail: A website, an API, a DNS record, a cron job...

getAlerted.label: 2. Get alerted
getAlerted.detail: Email works now. Add Slack, SMS or a phone call if you want to be woken up.

shareStatus.label: 3. Share status
shareStatus.detail: A status page tells your users what is going on before they ask.

welcome.help: Questions? Reply to this email. A human reads it.
welcome.introText: Thanks for joining SolidPing. We'll help you keep your services healthy and let you know the moment something goes wrong.
welcome.helpText: Need help getting started? Just reply to this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your SolidPing password
passwordReset.preheader: Set a new password. The link expires in {expiresIn}.
passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset your SolidPing password. Click below to set a new one.
passwordReset.introText: We received a request to reset your SolidPing password. Reset it here:
passwordReset.expiry: This reset link expires in {expiresIn}. If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will not change.

passwordResetSSO.preheader: You sign in with {providers}. Set a password below.
passwordResetSSO.intro: We received a request to reset your SolidPing password. You usually sign in to SolidPing with {providers}. You can keep doing that, or set a password with the link below.
passwordResetSSO.introText: We received a request to reset your SolidPing password. You usually sign in to SolidPing with {providers}. You can keep doing that, or set a password here:
passwordResetSSO.expiry: This reset link expires in {expiresIn}. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email. Nothing will change, and you can keep signing in with {providers}.

securityNotice.preheader: Changed on {date}. If that wasn't you, act now.
securityNotice.warning: If this wasn't you, contact your administrator immediately. Your account may be compromised.

emailChanged.title: Your email address was changed
emailChanged.body: The email address of your SolidPing account was changed from {oldEmail} to {newEmail} on {date}.
